star: Star Learner unlocked! 10 useful creations completed.
kept: Your newer draft edits are kept.
reasoning: What did you make, try and improve?
placeholder: Share your work, what you tried, what happened and what you changed. Use real results.
codeNote: Code is stored as text; it is not run here.
evidence: Share your work, real results and the change you made. A plan or made-up test is not completed work.
reviewScope: Your submitted evidence and supported repository files. AI does not run your project or witness your test.
paused: Reminders paused. Your draft is kept. Send REMIND ON to resume.
stopped: You will not get more WhatsLearn messages or reminders. Your draft is kept. Send START to resume lessons.
resumed: Reminders are on at your saved schedule.
question: Your decision
ready: Your draft is filled in. Reply *SAVE* for the final review or *EDIT* to change it.
linkHint: Optional https link. Only supported public GitHub source files are read during AI review; other links are references.
